evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: The imperative directly instructs complete removal, making it operationally settled rather than merely asserted; it does not establish a broader bedrock principle.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: The direct imperative and absolute scope make this an operationally settled instruction, though not an identity-level principle.
